mapper.sql: select si.stock_in_id, si.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, si.batch_no, si.operator, si.supplier_id, sc.org_name as supplier_name, si.type, CASE si.type WHEN '0' THEN '采购入库' WHEN '1' THEN '退货入库' ELSE '' END as type_desc, si.status, CASE si.status WHEN '0' THEN '未入库' WHEN '1' THEN '已入库' WHEN '2' THEN '作废' ELSE '' END as status_desc, si.total_quantity, si.qr_code, si.expired_time, si.remarks, si.create_people, si.create_time, si.update_people, si.update_time from inv_stock_in si left join inv_warehouse w on si.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id and w.del_flag = '0' left join supplier_cert sc on si.supplier_id = sc.user_id and sc.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select concat('SI-', date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d'), '-', lpad(ifnull(max(substring(stock_in_id, 13)), 0) + 1, 4, '0')) as stock_in_id from inv_stock_in where stock_in_id like concat('SI-', date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d'), '%') and del_flag = '0'

select concat('BN-', date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d'), '-', lpad(ifnull(max(substring(batch_no, 13)), 0) + 1, 4, '0')) as batch_no from inv_stock_in where batch_no like concat('BN-', date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d'), '%') and del_flag = '0'
